title: TAVI API — business hours check, 27 Oct 2026
lines: GET /iam/tenant/business-hours -> preset 24_7, all 7 days, timing_mode "same", hours 09:00–17:00, Africa/Cairo
PUT the same object back, unchanged -> 400 business_hours.invalid_timing_mode
"24_7 preset must have timing_mode, hours, hours_per_day, slots and slots_per_day all null."
PUT with Sunday off -> 400 "24_7 requires all 7 days."  (correct)
Stored record unchanged (read back); company fax and fiscal start month were changed and restored (200)
